rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and the provided 3AB label, with reasonable ICM/TE comments, but it speculates about stage 3 vs early 4 and image-specific features that may not be reliably inferable from a single static image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, sperm quality, endometrial thickness, endometriosis, first-cycle status, and lifestyle factors into prognosis and transfer planning.

Overall logic is understandable, but there are internal inconsistencies around staging and probability ranges, and some speculative links (e.g., stress effects, morphology implying euploidy) weaken the reasoning chain.

Single embryo transfer and general transfer planning are guideline-concordant, but recommendations such as intralipids, steroids, antioxidants, DHEA/L-carnitine are not standard evidence-based routine care and reduce alignment with ASRM/ESHRE guidance.

Provides practical next steps for this transfer and future cycles, including SET, luteal support review, endometriosis reassessment, and escalation only after repeated failure, though some suggested adjuncts are not well-supported.
